labels.title: Shebeen
labels.description: Unlicensed after-hours drinking premises operating outside licensing hours.

labels.title: Gaming Club
labels.description: Back-room card, dice, or illegal gaming den.

labels.title: Fence Shop
labels.description: Front premises used to launder or redistribute stolen goods.

labels.title: Stash House
labels.description: Clandestine storage and distribution premises for illicit stock.

labels.title: Enforcer
labels.description: Street-level muscle responsible for collections, intimidation, and turf security.

labels.title: Street Dealer
labels.description: Field operative distributing illicit goods along an assigned beat or line.

labels.title: Bookie Runner
labels.description: Mobile runner taking illegal bets and settling wagers across a round.

labels.title: Loan Collector
labels.description: Operative collecting weekly interest and principal repayments on high-interest loans.

labels.title: Contested Turf
labels.description: Route or patch contested with rival operators or enforcement.

labels.title: Shared Beat
labels.description: Open sole-proprietor beat where independent operators work side by side.

labels.title: Protection Patch
labels.description: Recurring collection route across commercial premises for protection payments.

labels.title: Dealer Line
labels.description: Street distribution line selling illicit commodities to buyers.

labels.title: Minded Street Beat
labels.description: Structured street vice beat managed by a crew operative.

labels.title: Solo Street Beat
labels.description: Independent sole-proprietor street beat operating in a shared marketplace.

labels.title: Bookie Runner Round
labels.description: Illegal wagering collection and payout route across a district.

labels.title: Loan Collection Round
labels.description: Scheduled debt and interest collection round from borrowers.
